notes.title: Release 2.0 ! Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed the file number verification in the last stage of the game.

notes.title: Patch - Train level
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixed[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of the lady in the train level running too fast.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a sprint option in the train level; you can use sprint to escape from the lady in the train level.
[*] Increase the area of light in the dark room in the train level.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Small
notes.notes:
Bug Fixed

[list]
[*] Issue of wrong file number (dummy 1.txt shown as dummy 0.txt) fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes: When you finish the game the first time and choose to go for the second ending, a new button in the main menu will be created, which will help you to understand how the game world works.
